theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.likePairBondProduct_zD (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) (a b : ℕ) :
(q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1)) ^ a * (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1) - (q - q⁻¹)) ^ b * (q ^ 4) ^ b = (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1)) ^ (a + b)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.nnFactor_mul_q_pow_four (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) :
(q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1) - (q - q⁻¹)) * q ^ 4 = q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.likePairBondProduct_eq_z_pow {R : Type u_3} [CommRing R] (zpp znn c : R) (hrel : znn * c = zpp) (a b : ℕ) :
zpp ^ a * znn ^ b * c ^ b = zpp ^ (a + b)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.flavorSplit_eq_bondGap (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) :
(q - 1) ^ 2 * (1 - (q ^ 4)⁻¹) / 3 = (q - 1) ^ 2 * ((q - q⁻¹) / (q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1))) / 3

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.nnFactor_eq_ppFactor_div_q_pow_four (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 < q) :
q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1) - (q - q⁻¹) = q ^ 3 / (q ^ 2 + 1) / q ^ 4

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.massFraction_like_pair (m : ℝ) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
m / (m + m) = 1 / 2

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.tPN_eq_proton_mass_fraction (mp mn : ℝ) (hpos : mp + mn ≠ 0) :
1 / 2 - (mn - mp) / ((mp + mn) / 2) / 4 = mp / (mp + mn)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.bond_factors_of_skein_letters {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (S : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [MathlibExt.HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower S] {g : ℕ} (h : R) (hq : S.g g * S.g g = h • S.g g + 1) {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ S.H g) (hb : b ∈ MarkovInteriorBond.upper (InteriorMarkovOfBraidedTower.toTowerB S) g) :
S.tr (a * S.g g * b) = (S.z + 0) * S.tr (a * b) ∧ S.tr (a * S.ginv g * b) = (S.z + -h) * S.tr (a * b) ∧ S.tr (a * (S.g g + S.ginv g) * b) = (2 * S.z - h) * S.tr (a * b)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.tr_bond_gen_add_ginv {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (S : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [MathlibExt.HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower S] {g : ℕ} (h : R) (hq : S.g g * S.g g = h • S.g g + 1) {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ S.H g) (hb : b ∈ MarkovInteriorBond.upper (InteriorMarkovOfBraidedTower.toTowerB S) g) :
S.tr (a * (S.g g + S.ginv g) * b) = (2 * S.z - h) * S.tr (a * b)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.tr_bond_ginv {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (S : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [MathlibExt.HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower S] {g : ℕ} (h : R) (hq : S.g g * S.g g = h • S.g g + 1) {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ S.H g) (hb : b ∈ MarkovInteriorBond.upper (InteriorMarkovOfBraidedTower.toTowerB S) g) :
S.tr (a * S.ginv g * b) = (S.z - h) * S.tr (a * b)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.tr_bond_gen {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (S : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [MathlibExt.HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower S] {g : ℕ} {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ S.H g) (hb : b ∈ MarkovInteriorBond.upper (InteriorMarkovOfBraidedTower.toTowerB S) g) :
S.tr (a * S.g g * b) = S.z * S.tr (a * b)

theorem QOU.Hecke.BondLetterIdentification.tr_bond_interp {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {A : Type u_2} [Ring A] [Algebra R A] (S : MathlibExt.OcneanuTrace.MarkovTrace R A) [MathlibExt.HeckeSandwichReduces.BraidedTower S] {g : ℕ} (t h : R) (hq : S.g g * S.g g = h • S.g g + 1) {a b : A} (ha : a ∈ S.H g) (hb : b ∈ MarkovInteriorBond.upper (InteriorMarkovOfBraidedTower.toTowerB S) g) :
S.tr (a * ((1 - t) • S.g g + t • S.ginv g) * b) = (S.z - h * t) * S.tr (a * b)
